Sanjeev Kapoor Reveals Reason for Declining MasterChef India Offer

Chef Sanjeev Kapoor recently disclosed why he rejected the offer to host 'MasterChef India' 16 years ago. According to Kapoor, his condition for accepting the role was to be paid one rupee more than actor Akshay Kumar. This revelation sheds light on the negotiations behind the popular cooking reality show's early days and Kapoor's stance on his professional value.
